title: The Naval Armada Battleship Radar
statement:
Given an N x M matrix board where each cell is a battleship 'X' or empty '.', return the number of the battleships on board.
Battleships can only be placed horizontally or vertically. At least one horizontal or vertical cell separates between any two battleships (no adjacent battleships).
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and M.
Next N lines: M space-separated characters ('X' or '.').

sampleCases.explanation: One 1x1 battleship at top-left, one 3x1 battleship at right column.

hiddenCases.input:
3 3
X X X
. . .
X X X
